## Measured failure

EI-25292075686873281 records a leader-control recovery that rearmed an inactive monitor while retaining remainingNoDeltaBudget: 0. The origin was ensureFleetLeaderControl: it treated every inactive loop as a missing wake source and materialized it without consulting exhaustion evidence. The pre-fix maintained regression fe375d15 /20883467 reproduced three materialization calls for exhausted status, payload, and marker-only fixtures; ordinary positive-budget controls passed.

## Recovery boundary

An active loop remains untouched. For an inactive monitor, zero remaining budget in either saved status or payload suppresses materialization. When monitor config is absent, no_delta_budget_exhausted standdown metadata also prevents manufacturing a default budget. Intentional standdown is returned as loop.standdown while loop.healthy remains true: healthy means no recovery is needed, not that a periodic loop is active. Inbox and standing transition-watch reconciliation still run; blocker watches are neither consumed nor canceled.

A historical standdown marker alone must not defeat a later explicitly renewed positive budget. MaterializeLoop retains that historical metadata, so the current monitor config is necessary to interpret it. Recovery retains an unexhausted config and the existing onlyIfInactive race guard; explicit loop:arm semantics are unchanged.

## Verification and limits

The conventional leader-control test checks zero-budget evidence independently of the historical marker, watch custody, marker-only legacy recovery, and positive-budget renewal. Full source verification 6fd3f897 passed 213 tests across leader-control, loop:arm, monitor-policy, and monitor-standdown. This is local source evidence, not proof that an operator loaded the change. Operator-api acceptance requires the containing origin/staging build on :3170 and its measured request/response. Never resurrect a real exhausted monitor merely to obtain verification.

Keep the original wake-transport incident EI-25257321199641888 separate: its first attempt's cause remains unknown; current socket reachability and historical delivery errors measure different times and predicates.
